records.source: Sometimes, a strange feeling comes over me. My head becomes totally empty... and I feel completely at peace, even blissful.#$e#Hey, now! It has nothing to do with drinking wine!$h
records.translation: Minsan ay may kakaibang damdaming bumabalot sa akin. Nagiging ganap na blangko ang isip ko... at lubos akong napapayapa, naliligayahan pa nga.#$e#Hoy! Wala itong kinalaman sa pag-inom ng alak!$h

records.source: Do you ever wonder what it's like to be a different person?#$e#Do our thoughts manifest in a similar way, or is it radically different?#$e#Don't mind me, I think about weird things sometimes...$h
records.translation: Naiisip mo ba kung ano kaya ang pakiramdam ng maging ibang tao?#$e#Magkakahawig ba ang paraan ng paglitaw ng mga kaisipan natin, o lubos itong naiiba?#$e#Huwag mo akong pansinin, kung minsan ay nag-iisip ako ng mga kakaibang bagay...$h

records.source: I love to decorate for the different seasons.
records.translation: Gustung-gusto kong magdekorasyon para sa iba't ibang panahon.

records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#I've thought about growing some crops, but I think I'd feel bad having to clear out all the wild plants to make space.|Farming sounds so fun. I want to try it, someday.$l
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Naisip kong magtanim ng ilang pananim, pero parang masasaktan ang loob ko kung aalisin ko ang lahat ng ligaw na halaman para magkaroon ng puwang.|Mukhang napakasaya ng pagsasaka. Gusto kong subukan iyon balang araw.$l

records.source: If you hear any banging from inside my hut, it's probably just me working on one of my sculptures.
records.translation: Kung makarinig ka ng anumang kalabog mula sa loob ng Kubo ko, malamang ay gumagawa lang ako ng isa sa mga eskultura ko.

records.source: If you ever find any interesting looking driftwood, I could use it.#$e#It would be special that you gave it to me.
records.translation: Kung makakita ka ng inaanod na kahoy na kawili-wili ang anyo, magagamit ko iyon.#$e#Magiging espesyal iyon dahil ibinigay mo sa akin.

records.source: ...What?$7#$b#Oh! Yeah, that's absolutely right!$h
records.translation: ...Ano?$7#$b#Oh! Oo, talagang tama iyan!$h

records.source: There's nothing wrong with that... I think there's lots of beauty to be found in raw, untouched nature!#$b#But as a human, I'm also interested in how we shape and interpret the world around us... I guess what I'm saying is that I'm interested in 'art'.
records.translation: Walang masama roon... Sa tingin ko'y napakaraming kagandahang matatagpuan sa hilaw at di-nagalaw na kalikasan!#$b#Pero bilang tao, interesado rin ako sa paraan ng paghubog at pagpapakahulugan natin sa mundong nakapaligid sa atin... Siguro ang sinasabi ko ay interesado ako sa “sining”.

records.source: You pig!%fork$a^Oh! You're...? Me too.$6#$b#Get out!$a^That's good to know.$l
records.translation: Baboy ka!%fork$a^Oh! Ikaw ay...? Ako rin.$6#$b#Lumayas ka!$a^Mabuting malaman iyan.$l

records.source: You're right... I just wouldn't have been happy back there.$u#$b#It was better for both of us... to end an unsustainable relationship while we were still young and flexible.$u
records.translation: Tama ka... Hindi lang talaga ako magiging masaya roon.$u#$b#Mas mabuti para sa aming dalawa... na wakasan ang relasyong hindi magtatagal habang bata pa kami at kaya pang magbago.$u

records.source: That's a little harsh... but, yeah. We had different priorities.$u
records.translation: Medyo malupit naman iyon... pero, oo. Magkaiba ang mga pinahahalagahan namin.$u

records.source: Oh yeah? Well maybe I'll just leave, then!%fork$a
records.translation: Ah, ganoon? Baka umalis na lang ako kung gayon!%fork$a

records.source: *sigh*...$s#$b#I guess you're right... it was kind of selfish. But can you really blame me for wanting to be happy? Ugh... I don't know...$s
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*...$s#$b#Siguro ay tama ka... medyo makasarili iyon. Pero masisisi mo ba talaga ako sa pagnanais na maging masaya? Ugh... Hindi ko alam...$s

records.source: *sigh*...$s#$b#Maybe you're right... Humans are selfish creatures. I don't know. $s#$b#I probably shouldn't dwell on it. We all have to make hard choices from time to time.$s
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*...$s#$b#Baka tama ka... Makasariling nilalang ang mga tao. Hindi ko alam. $s#$b#Marahil ay hindi ko dapat iyon pag-isipan nang paulit-ulit. Kailangan nating lahat na gumawa paminsan-minsan ng mahihirap na pasiya.$s

records.source: You can tell it's summer by the sweet smell of nectar wafting through the air!$h
records.translation: Malalaman mong tag-init na dahil sa matamis na halimuyak ng nektar na sumasabay sa hangin!$h

records.source: I found some wild fruits this morning!#$e#Sorry, I don't have any left.$s#$e#Keep looking, I'm sure you'll find something.
records.translation: Nakakita ako ng ilang ligaw na prutas kaninang umaga!#$e#Paumanhin, wala nang natira.$s#$e#Patuloy ka lang maghanap, sigurado akong may makikita ka.

records.source: The sound of farm animals is great, isn't it?
records.translation: Napakaganda ng tunog ng mga hayop sa bukid, hindi ba?

records.source: The simple things in life are best: a soft summer breeze, majestic clouds, and a goblet full of Stardew Valley red.
records.translation: Ang mga simpleng bagay sa buhay ang pinakamainam: banayad na simoy ng tag-init, mariringal na ulap, at isang kopang punô ng pulang alak mula sa Stardew Valley.

records.source: I have a good eye for wild fruit. Some day I'll make you a nice fruit salad.$h
records.translation: Matalas ang mata ko sa ligaw na prutas. Balang araw ay gagawan kita ng masarap na salad ng prutas.$h

records.source: You can use a tapper to harvest syrups and other useful liquids directly from trees.#$e#It's a slow process, but the result can be quite valuable.
records.translation: Maaari kang gumamit ng Panistis upang kumuha ng mga arnibal at iba pang kapaki-pakinabang na likido nang direkta mula sa mga puno.#$e#Mabagal ang proseso, pero maaaring maging napakahalaga ng resulta.

records.source: I hate to be blunt, but if we don't treat nature with respect, our grandchildren will be doomed.#$e#Don't you think so?
records.translation: Ayaw kong maging prangka, pero kung hindi natin igagalang ang kalikasan, mapapahamak ang mga apo natin.#$e#Hindi ba?

records.source: Do you ever walk out into the forest... Pause... And simply enjoy the beauty of nature?#$e#It's easy to forget how incredible this world actually is...
records.translation: Naglalakad ka ba kung minsan papasok sa kagubatan... Humihinto... At basta ninanamnam ang kagandahan ng kalikasan?#$e#Madaling malimutan kung gaano talaga kamangha-mangha ang mundong ito...

records.source: Hello, @. Do you ever get lonely on that big farm?#$e#Stop by my cabin if you ever need someone to talk to.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Nalulungkot ka ba kung minsan sa malaking bukid na iyon?#$e#Dumaan ka sa Kubo ko kung kailangan mo ng makakausap.$h

records.source: The flowing water keeps my house a little bit cooler in summer.#$e#I can't tolerate heat very well.
records.translation: Pinananatiling medyo malamig ng dumadaloy na tubig ang bahay ko sa tag-init.#$e#Hindi ko gaanong kaya ang init.

records.source: One Summer, it was so hot during the night that I got out of bed and jumped into the river!#$e#I hope no one saw me!$h
records.translation: Isang tag-init, napakainit sa gabi kaya bumangon ako at tumalon sa ilog!#$e#Sana ay walang nakakita sa akin!$h

records.source: What should I do on such a warm, lazy day? *sigh*#$e#Any ideas?
records.translation: Ano ang dapat kong gawin sa ganitong mainit at nakatatamad na araw? *Buntong-hininga*#$e#May ideya ka ba?

records.source: How quickly the seasons change!#$e#It's shocking.
records.translation: Kaybilis magbago ng mga panahon!#$e#Nakagugulat.

records.source: #$c .5#I found some wild mushrooms over the weekend!#$e#I had a huge plate of wild mushrooms and eggs for breakfast today... I'm still full.#$e#Keep your nose to the ground and you'll find some mushrooms yourself... I'm sure of it.
records.translation: #$c .5#Nakakita ako ng ilang ligaw na kabute noong katapusan ng linggo!#$e#Kumain ako kaninang almusal ng isang malaking plato ng ligaw na kabute at itlog... Busog pa rin ako.#$e#Panatilihin mong malapit sa lupa ang ilong mo at makakakita ka rin ng ilang kabute... Sigurado ako.

records.source: I wonder if I could make a collage out of dried leaves?#$e#They're just so colorful... I can't help but think of the potential for art projects.$h
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung makagagawa kaya ako ng kolahe mula sa mga tuyong dahon?#$e#Napakukulay kasi nila... hindi ko maiwasang isipin ang maaaring gawing proyektong pansining sa mga ito.$h

records.source: Everyone has a unique and interesting perspective, whether they believe it or not. Don't you think so?#$e#Although, some people have opinions that I just can't respect.
records.translation: May natatangi at kawili-wiling pananaw ang bawat tao, naniniwala man sila rito o hindi. Hindi ba?#$e#Gayunman, may mga taong may opinyong hindi ko talaga kayang igalang.

records.source: It's so nice to live by the river.#$e#I fall asleep to the soothing sound of water every night.
records.translation: Napakasarap tumira sa tabi ng ilog.#$e#Nakatutulog ako gabi-gabi sa nakagiginhawang tunog ng tubig.

records.source: One of these days I'll have to make you a wild mushroom stir-fry.$h
records.translation: Balang araw ay kailangan kitang gawan ng ginisang ligaw na kabute.$h

records.source: Do you have a kitchen in your house?#$e#If you have a kitchen, you can cook all kinds of delicious meals.$h
records.translation: May kusina ba sa bahay mo?#$e#Kung may kusina ka, makapagluluto ka ng sari-saring masasarap na pagkain.$h

records.source: Stop by my cabin if you ever need someone to talk to.$h
records.translation: Dumaan ka sa Kubo ko kung kailangan mo ng makakausap.$h

records.source: Decorations accentuate the feeling of the season. I think it's a worthwhile tradition.
records.translation: Lalong pinatitingkad ng mga palamuti ang damdamin ng panahon. Sa tingin ko'y karapat-dapat ipagpatuloy ang tradisyong ito.

records.source: There's a lot of good places to walk around here.#$e#It feels good to stretch your legs.
records.translation: Maraming magagandang lugar na maaaring lakaran dito.#$e#Masarap sa pakiramdam ang iunat ang mga binti.

records.source: One thing I love about this place is that there are beautiful waterfalls.#$e#Do you ever spend time watching them? It's soothing...
records.translation: Isa sa mga gusto ko sa lugar na ito ay ang magagandang talon.#$e#Naglalaan ka ba ng oras upang pagmasdan ang mga ito? Nakagiginhawa iyon...

records.source: I love the way everything looks when it's covered with fresh snow.
records.translation: Gustung-gusto ko ang hitsura ng lahat kapag natatakpan ng bagong bagsak na niyebe.

records.source: It gets pretty cold in my little cabin.$s#$e#I just snuggle up under a huge blanket, and I'm okay.$h
records.translation: Talagang lumalamig sa munting Kubo ko.$s#$e#Nagbabalot lang ako sa napakalaking kumot, at ayos na ako.$h

records.source: I saw a snow rabbit early this morning! They're rare, aren't they?
records.translation: Nakakita ako ng kunehong-niyebe kaninang madaling-araw! Bihira sila, hindi ba?

records.source: I'm having a hard time finding fresh food to eat.#$e#I've been eating a lot of bread.$s
records.translation: Nahihirapan akong makahanap ng sariwang makakain.#$e#Marami akong kinakain na tinapay.$s

records.source: *Sigh*... It's hard to get fresh food in the winter.#$e#I bet your farm is pretty well stocked with food, huh?
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... Mahirap makakuha ng sariwang pagkain sa taglamig.#$e#Tiyak na maraming nakaimbak na pagkain sa bukid mo, ano?

records.source: Time seems to move slower here.#$e#When I lived in the city, the year went by so fast.
records.translation: Parang mas mabagal ang paglipas ng oras dito.#$e#Noong nakatira ako sa lungsod, napakabilis lumipas ng taon.

records.source: Do you ever get cold in that farmhouse of yours?#$e#Stop by my cabin if you want to huddle under one of my quilts and drink cider.$h
records.translation: Nilalamig ka ba kung minsan sa Bahay-Bukid mo?#$e#Dumaan ka sa Kubo ko kung gusto mong magkumot gamit ang isa sa mga kubrekama ko at uminom ng sidra.$h

records.source: Hello. Do you want something?
records.translation: Kumusta. May kailangan ka ba?

records.source: Hello, @. Is there something you wanted to talk about?
records.translation: Kumusta, @. May gusto ka bang pag-usapan?

records.source: Do you ever take a whole day off?#$e#It's a refreshing break.
records.translation: Naglalaan ka ba kung minsan ng isang buong araw para magpahinga?#$e#Nakapagpapasiglang pahinga iyon.

records.source: You should take a whole day off, now and then.#$b#Not only is it good for the soul, but in the long run, you'll actually be more productive!
records.translation: Dapat kang magpahinga nang isang buong araw paminsan-minsan.#$b#Hindi lang iyon mabuti para sa kaluluwa; sa kalaunan ay lalo ka pa ngang magiging produktibo!
